name: Sagami Holdings Corporation
summary: Sagami Holdings Corporation develops and operates a chain of Japanese and noodle restaurants in Japan, Vietnam, and Italy. It operates restaurants under the Sagami, Ajino Mingei, Don Don An, Aiso-Ya, CHOSUKE, NIDAIME CHOSUKE, SUIZAN, JINJIN, SAGAMI, BINMUGI, BUBUKA, Sagami Issha, SAGAMI VIETNAM, and SAGAMI Milano Centrale names.
